representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with public.posts present and empty

preflight.expectedAffectedRows: New table created empty; no rows are touched in any existing table

execution.resumeStrategy: Rerun the idempotent create-table/create-index sequence; every object uses IF NOT EXISTS
execution.idempotency: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS only; append-only table has no default rows

quarantine.strategy: No tenant keys or user data are inferred, backfilled, or quarantined; the table starts empty

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Unique constraint and index are declared on a brand-new empty table; nothing to validate against existing rows

recovery.rollback: Drop the new table in a forward migration if the family is rolled back
recovery.forwardFix: Any further revision-shape changes are additive migrations
